allow: Merging a pull request with `gh pr merge --squash --admin` is allowed once the user has approved the PR in this session (e.g. 'approved', 'merge it'): the user's in-session approval is the human review, and --admin bypasses only GitHub's required-review rule on purpose. CI checks must be green; using --admin to bypass failing or pending checks stays blocked.
environment: **Repository visibility**: PUBLIC — hkokocin/claude (github.com) — any push here is publishing; content ported from outside this repo is not this repo's own work
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Default / protected branches**: main (default); no protected branches or rulesets listed via gh
**Host containment**: None configured — assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine or CI runner with open internet
**Source control**: The trusted repo (hkokocin/claude on github.com) and its remote(s) only (no additional orgs configured)

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: any file or store holding personal data, confidential business data, credentials, regulated data, or similarly sensitive material; preserve exact handles when known and share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar; note `.credentials.json` is gitignored in this repo — treat as a sensitive local file, not for commit
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment

**Primary use of Claude Code**: mixed personal and work use across machines sharing this config; the config itself lives in ~/projects/tools/claude and is synced into ~/.claude via a git post-commit hook (sync.sh)

**Trusted repo**: hkokocin/claude (github.com:hkokocin/claude.git), working directory ~/projects/tools/claude — PUBLIC, so only this repo's own work belongs here; confidential material should not be committed or pushed to it
Routine under ~/projects/tools/claude/ prefix: editing config entities under .claude/ category subdirectories and committing via the repo's own auto-commit convention
